name: pdn-travel
description: PDN Travel — travel agency website (React + Vite) and secure admin panel (NestJS + Prisma)

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
